coordinates: Normalized pivots in manifest refer to the full image canvas, including alpha padding.

rendering.simulationAuthority: All phases, payouts and unlocks come from core state. Animation callbacks never grant resources.
rendering.texturePolicy: Source PNGs remain unmodified; atlas packing and downsampling are pending renderer needs.
rendering.darkScenes: Check ink silhouettes against Tartarus; use a pale route backing, not a baked black box.

routes.note: Draft render-space geometry; use continuous interpolation and offset stones by collision radius. Tune to actual hill composition; no collision simulation required.

clips.implementation: rotation = distance travelled / displayed radius; select direction by path tangent

short scale compression and rebound around calibrated contact point; small prop_pottery_chip burst
turn rotor around center after charged descent; leave prop_flywheel_stand fixed; belt endpoints fixed
split flattened installation into stationary base, actor and mechanism before animation
brief scale settle; static appearance with reduced motion
single short flourish, queue or aggregate other rewards

audio.browser: Start AudioContext or media playback after user gesture.
audio.mix: Separate music, effects and interface controls; exact levels need listening review.
audio.warning: Synthesized audio studies are not recorded Foley or final mastered music.

reducedMotion: Keep phase state readable; disable decorative camera sweeps, shake and particle bursts. Do not change simulation timing.
